newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to decide on rice bids in two days.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to decide on rice bids in two days.

text.p: The state-run Rice Export Corporation of Pakistan is likely to take a decision on three bids for the sale and export of 5,000 tonnes of basmati variety Pak-7 1996/97 (July-June) rice, containing seven percent broken, in the next two days, an official said on Wednesday.
He said the highest bid was $436 per tonne FOB, with the others at $435.10 and $425. Bids were opened on May 26.
Pakistan exported 1.571 million tonnes of rice worth $393 million in the first 10 months of 1996/97 compared to 1.133 million worth $372 million in the same period a year-ago.
In April, rice exports fell to 180,094 tonnes worth $48 million compared to 372,828 tonnes worth $62 million in March and 118,141 tonnes worth $38 million in April 1996.
